name: KodCode
intro: KodCode 是一个用于代码模型后训练的大规模全合成可验证数据集。它从 12 个子集生成多样问题，经语义去重后由 GPT-4o 同时生成解答与单元测试，并要求测试全过和 100% 分支覆盖率。第二阶段得到 279K 个已验证三元组，风格转换再增加 168K，形成 447K 条 RL 数据；DeepSeek-R1 三次采样与测试拒绝采样另构建 SFT 数据。
org: Microsoft GenAI, University of Washington, The University of Texas at Austin
build_method: 自动合成, 单元测试自验证, 拒绝采样
task_type: 合成代码数据, 代码生成
eval_feature: 可执行验证, 分支覆盖, 污染分析
scale: 447K 已验证问题-解答-测试三元组
build_method_en: Automated Synthesis, Unit-test Self-verification, Reject Sampling
eval_feature_en: Executable Verification, Branch Coverage, Contamination Analysis
intro_en: KodCode is a large-scale fully synthetic, verifiable dataset for code-model post-training. It generates diverse questions from 12 subsets, semantically deduplicates them, and has GPT-4o jointly generate solutions and unit tests that must all pass with 100% branch coverage. Step 2 yields 279K verified triplets; style conversion adds 168K for 447K RL items, while three DeepSeek-R1 samples per question and test-based rejection form SFT data.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.02951 Sections 2–4 and official repository snapshot 3a98720. The diagram distinguishes the 279K self-verified triplets, 168K style-converted additions, final 447K RL-ready triplets, and the separate DeepSeek-R1 three-sample/test-rejection SFT branch. It also preserves up-to-10 fresh attempts, 100% branch coverage, 94 flagged benchmark overlaps, and downstream Pass@1 evaluation.
